Find CDC HIV-related service providers by ZIP code

Source: R/providers.R
cdc_providers.Rd

Queries the CDC Locator API to return service providers within a given radius of a ZIP code.

Usage

cdc_providers(
  zipcode,
  radius = 10,
  services = NULL,
  client_id = NULL,
  client_token = NULL
)

Arguments

zipcode

Character scalar. ZIP code.

radius

Integer search radius in miles (1–50, default: 10).

services

Character vector of services to search for, matched in any case: "hivtesting", "stdtesting", "selftesting", "preptesting", "pep", "condom", "hepc", "doxypep", "mailintesting", "ryanwhite", "clinics", "substanceabuse", "mentalhealth" or "housing". NULL, the default, searches for all of them. More than three services take more than one request.

client_id

Optional CDC client ID override.

client_token

Optional CDC client token override.

Value

A tibble of service providers.

Details

The API returns providers offering any of the requested services, but returned no providers when all 14 services were requested at once (observed 2026-11-16). So services are requested at most three at a time, and the results are combined: the default, every service, takes five requests. Providers returned by more than one request are kept once, by id.
